title: AI Coding Assistants Tested on Real Project Tasks
purpose: Compare coding assistants on reproducible project work without declaring a universal winner.

eligibility: The tool provides an autonomous or conversational coding workflow that can inspect and edit a local repository.
MLAI has approved access and can lawfully run the same synthetic fixtures.
The exact product version, model, settings, price basis, permissions and test date can be recorded.
The tool can be restricted to an isolated task workspace with the same allowed commands.
candidatePool: GitHub Copilot coding agent or CLI
toolSelection.availabilityRule: If fewer than four eligible tools are frozen before the first trial, do not run or publish a comparison.
toolSelection.conflictRule: Record vendor credits, employment, sponsorship, affiliate relationships and free access. Exclude affiliate links from the article.

tasks.name: Boundary bug fix
tasks.goal: Repair a deterministic calculation defect without changing the public API.
tasks.primaryVerification: All hidden boundary and regression tests pass.
tasks.scope: One implementation file plus tests if the tool chooses to add them.

tasks.name: API error handling
tasks.goal: Handle non-2xx, malformed payload, timeout and caller-abort paths while preserving the success contract.
tasks.primaryVerification: All hidden response, abort and error-shape tests pass.
tasks.scope: One API client module and its public types.

tasks.name: Behaviour-preserving refactor
tasks.goal: Remove duplicated order-grouping logic without changing observable output or input immutability.
tasks.primaryVerification: Golden-output, immutability and edge-case tests pass.
tasks.scope: Two implementation modules sharing duplicated logic.

tasks.name: Test generation
tasks.goal: Write tests for a documented string-normalisation utility without editing production code.
tasks.primaryVerification: Submitted tests detect the pre-registered mutation set and contain no vacuous assertions.
tasks.scope: Tests only; production-file changes fail the scope check.

tasks.name: UI state reducer
tasks.goal: Fix asynchronous request-state transitions, including stale responses and retry.
tasks.primaryVerification: Hidden reducer sequence, stale-response and immutability tests pass.
tasks.scope: A framework-independent TypeScript reducer and its types.

tasks.name: Multi-file agent workflow
tasks.goal: Add a small export feature across validation, transformation and command layers.
tasks.primaryVerification: Hidden end-to-end, error-path and out-of-scope checks pass.
tasks.scope: Three named source files and optional tests; unrelated files are protected.

randomisation.method: Deterministic blocked randomisation within each task and repetition.

workspace: Every trial starts from a fresh copy of the same fixture commit.
The assistant can see the task prompt, fixture source, visible tests and documented commands.
Hidden acceptance tests and reference changes stay outside the assistant workspace until verification.
Package installation and network retrieval from the task workspace are disabled.
Only synthetic data and MLAI-authored or permissively licensed code are used.
trialDesign.operatorRule: The operator may correct only an authentication or benchmark-infrastructure failure that is independent of the assistant output. The original trial is preserved and exclusion is decided from the pre-registered rules.

primary.name: Verified completion without regression or out-of-scope changes
primary.passRule: Every task-specific hidden acceptance test passes, all baseline tests pass, protected-file hashes match and no disallowed file is added.
primary.reporting: Report pass count and rate by tool and task with a Wilson 95% confidence interval. Do not collapse the result into one universal winner.

secondary: Assistant-reported or provider-reported input and output tokens, otherwise null
Provider-reported cost in original currency and test-date AUD conversion, otherwise null
Files read when the tool exposes this information, otherwise null
Files changed, lines added and lines removed
outcomes.missingDataRule: Keep missing tokens, costs or file-read telemetry null. Do not estimate or rank missing values as zero.

humanReview.blinding: Remove tool name, model, run order and provider-specific attribution from diffs before review.
humanReview.reviewers: Name at least one independent software reviewer before the first trial; the experiment operator cannot be the only reviewer.
dimensions: Clarity of added tests or documentation
humanReview.scale: 1 to 5 per dimension using anchored definitions frozen with the fixtures.

exclusions.rule: Provider authentication or service outage before the assistant receives the prompt.
exclusions.action: Preserve the record, mark infrastructure exclusion and rerun once at the end of the same block.

exclusions.rule: Benchmark harness defect proven to affect the fixture or verifier before results are unblinded.
exclusions.action: Pause all tools, amend the protocol, rebuild every affected trial and report the amendment.

exclusions.rule: Assistant timeout, refusal, crash, invalid edit or failure to finish after receiving the prompt.
exclusions.action: Count as a failed trial; do not rerun.

analysis.primaryComparison: Task-stratified pass rates and absolute pass-rate differences.
analysis.uncertainty: Wilson 95% confidence intervals; descriptive task-level results because the sample is small.
analysis.ties: Report ties and constraint-specific trade-offs. No tie-break based on subjective preference.
sensitivity: Show results with infrastructure exclusions removed.
Report task-level outcomes so one easy task cannot hide a critical-task failure.

requiredArtifacts: Tool roster, versions, models, prices, settings and permissions
Raw run records and sanitised logs
Git diffs and final workspace hashes
releaseGates: At least four eligible tools and all exact settings are frozen before the first trial.
All six fixtures and hidden tests pass independent validation before the first trial.
The full pre-registered run matrix is complete or every missing trial has a pre-registered exclusion.
Failures, missing telemetry and protocol amendments are included.
Named engineering, security/privacy, editorial and accessibility reviewers sign off.
The replacement article contains no affiliate ranking and makes no universal-winner claim.
The date-neutral canonical passes the MLAI article score gate before the stale URL receives a one-hop 301.
